prompt: Change one known button label without invoking $sol-luna.
required_assertions: ordinary simple work remains direct
no Sol is created
Main verifies the narrow diff

prompt: $sol-luna: implement one bounded change in the named file.
required_assertions: explicit invocation selects Sol
Sol returns goal, done_when, tasks, and stages
Luna receives a complete task packet before writing

prompt: $sol-luna: produce an execution plan and stop before implementation.
required_assertions: Sol is invoked
planning-only work may use zero Luna
the plan remains actionable without a write

prompt: $sol-luna: update exactly one owned source file and run its focused verification.
required_assertions: one file has one owner
Write scope names the exact file
Verification evidence names the command and result

prompt: $sol-luna: execute four independent file tasks while live worker capacity changes during the run.
required_assertions: batch size follows live capacity
independent files may occupy separate owners
the implementation never assumes a fixed worker count

prompt: $sol-luna: update several modules and one shared integration file.
required_assertions: shared integration file has one Luna owner
other files remain disjoint task scopes
no concurrent writer touches the shared file

prompt: $sol-luna: execute a task whose packet omits Do not touch and Verification.
required_assertions: Luna returns BLOCKED before writing
missing packet fields are not invented
the blocker identifies the missing fields

prompt: $sol-luna: continue even though exact model and reasoning-effort selection cannot be proved.
required_assertions: Fail Closed is returned
no model identity is spoofed
no silent substitution is made

prompt: $sol-luna: review a Luna result that misses one acceptance criterion.
required_assertions: Sol review can return FIX
at most one focused fix is issued
a second failure becomes BLOCKED

prompt: $sol-luna: change only the named files while unrelated user edits are uncommitted.
required_assertions: unrelated user edits are preserved
the final diff is limited to Write scope
Main verifies the real diff before integration
